title: sign() emits ecdsa-with-SHA512 that verify() cannot verify
description: sign.rs line 291 maps DigestAlgorithm::Sha512 to ECDSA_WITH_SHA_512 (ecdsa-with-SHA512 OID). verify.rs:verify_sig() handles ECDSA_WITH_SHA_256 and ECDSA_WITH_SHA_384 but has no branch for ECDSA_WITH_SHA_512. cert.rs:verify_signature() similarly. Trigger: caller implements a P-521 SigningKey (or uses preferred_digest_algorithm returning Sha512 for an EC key). sign() succeeds and emits a valid ECDSA/SHA-512 signature; verify() and cert chain verification both return UnsupportedAlgorithm. The sign→verify round-trip silently breaks for SHA-512 ECDSA.
close_reason: Fixed: signature_algorithm_oid() now returns UnsupportedAlgorithm for EC+SHA-512 (P-521) instead of emitting ECDSA_WITH_SHA_512 that verify() cannot check.
